blind.table_distance_name: tipped ore cart with spilled ore
blind.description: A stylized wooden minecart tipped onto its side, spilling a mound of rough ore or rock. The cart features warm brown/orange wood planks reinforced with dark iron brackets, rivets, small flanged wheels, and iron tow hitches. The spilled cargo forms an irregular rocky mound with mottled reddish-brown, copper, and oxidized greenish patches. The surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating geometry, resting naturally on the ground without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: Shows the rectangular wooden undercarriage/side of the cart with two wheels visible along the left, resting against a rounded, uneven heap of brown and green speckled ore spilling out to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 ft tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft across the rock pile.

match.reads_as: tipped ore cart with spilled ore
